scope.ray_generation: prepared CUDA mounted sensor poses to contiguous world origin/direction arrays
scope.trace: fixed CUDA rays to owned CUDA closest-hit results; camera includes target-only query
scope.postprocess: fixed raw hits/rays to formal sensor output; no tracing
scope.pipeline: ray generation plus trace; prepared mounted poses, no sensor postprocess
scope.end_to_end: formal sample_depth(weighted_quantile)/sample_camera/sample_rig on CUDA poses; rig includes mount composition
scope.excluded: map parsing, CPU pose generation/upload, renderer/BVH setup, motion, GUI/HTTP/image encoding
scope.nonadditive: stages independently synchronized and timed; medians need not add
scope.residency: all timed inputs/outputs remain CUDA tensors; parity downloads happen outside timers

input.algorithm: first historical pose; subsequent numpy.default_rng.uniform(-1,1,6), translation (.25,.25,.15)m, RPY offsets (8,6,12)deg; prefix-stable across B
input.target_policy: center lies on first view forward axis; geometry still participates in normal background occlusion
input.historical_case_note: historical target center is about 4.348m away, radius .3m; its nearest surface exceeds the new 4m ToF range and is deliberately not used as the default performance target

scene_bvh_setup_scope: CPU geometry assembly, scene tensor upload and native Warp BVH construction; excludes prior explicit Warp init; not exclusive BVH-kernel timing

global_before.scope: whole CUDA device including desktop/other processes; shared-device approximation

global_after.scope: whole CUDA device including desktop/other processes; shared-device approximation

scene_memory.global_delta_scope: shared device approximate delta, includes allocator reservations and other processes; not exact Warp BVH size

explicit.tracked_total_scope: owned scene tensor storage; excludes Warp BVH/allocator/driver and query outputs

geometry.batch_geometry_policy: one static mesh BVH and shared analytic spheres; independent of ray count
geometry.input: world origins/directions float32 CUDA N3; radial max distance scalar or CUDA N
geometry.output: owned CUDA radial distance, object/triangle index and world hit point
geometry.near_clip_policy: none; nearest nonnegative surface before measurement validity
geometry.selection_policy: full scene or one analytic sphere; static mesh selection unsupported

first_forward_scope: first formal API call; includes any uncached Warp JIT/module load, lazy sensor constants and PyTorch initialization

ray_generation.cuda_event_scope: entire current-stream interval, including CPU submission gaps; not pure kernel time
